name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
summary: Lucien Tosselwrench knows how cheap Lotwil can be, and offers to make something for your trouble: enchanted bracers built from the extra stones you collected. What Lucien lacks is a blacksmith's patterned bronze bracers.

sections.title: A Thank-You for Your Trouble
sections.body: After the Study of the Elements: Rock trials, Lucien Tosselwrench admits how cheap Lotwil can be and wants to make it up to you. Lucien has been busy with the extra stones you gathered and can make fine enchanted bracers. They may even help guard you against what Lucien calls the coming atrocity of Lotwil's newest invention.

sections.title: What Lucien Needs
sections.body: To finish the bracers, Lucien needs patterned bronze bracers, the kind a blacksmith makes. Lucien warns that it is wise not to wait long, since no one knows what happens next.

faq.q: Who offers to craft the bracers?
aliases: who gives stone is better than cloth
faq.answer: Lucien Tosselwrench, in the Badlands, offers to make enchanted bracers from the extra stones you collected.

faq.q: Why is Lucien making this armor for you?
faq.answer: Lucien knows how cheap Lotwil can be and wants to make something for all your troubles. It may also help protect you from Lotwil's newest invention.

faq.q: What does Lucien need to finish crafting the bracers?
faq.answer: Patterned bronze bracers, the kind a blacksmith makes.

aliases: prerequisite for stone is better than cloth
faq.answer: It follows Lotwil's third Study of the Elements: Rock request.

angles.text: The bronze bracers Lucien wants come from a blacksmith.
